title: Giving feedback about the Department of Building Inspection (DBI)

paragraphs: For language access or giving feedback about a specific employee.

sections.heading: Language access
paragraphs: If we did not provide the language assistance you need, give feedback to help us improve.
Download the form and fill it out. Send it to us by mail or email.
Filipino - Form para sa reklamo sa language access
Spanish- formulario de quejas de acceso a idiomas

sections.heading: Customer service
paragraphs: For feedback about a specific employee, email or call their manager. You can find the employee’s manager in these organizational charts.
This feedback will be reviewed by DBI Human Resources. The results of your feedback will be confidential to the extent allowed by the law.
